term: finite obstruction to every object being composite
definition: FiniteBoundary says no finite inhabited partial order satisfies every object having a strict proper part. Mathlib NoMinOrder.infinite supplies the obstruction. It does not say every infinite domain is atomless or that finite models cannot distinguish other mereological properties.
